# Visual Handoff — Sample Deep Dive: The Oleshky Truce

**Coverage:** Mon 26 – Sat 31 Oct 2026 (event: Tue 27 Oct 2026)
**Version:** v2 (both reviews applied) · **Status:** INTERNAL reference, never published
**Aspect:** 16:9, 1920 × 1080, 30 fps (review previews at 24 fps)
**Build:** every visual in this video is generated by code in `tools/masterclass-video/`. Nothing is hand-edited, and there are no AI images.
**Brand:**

| Colour | Use |
|---|---|
| Slate #1E2228 | Background |
| Yellow #F5D300 | Keywords |
| White #FFFFFF | Body text |
| Trap red #E5484D | Prelims Trap cards |
| Teal #2BB3A3 | Telugu States Lens cards |
| River blue #4A90C2 | Rivers and water bodies |

**Fonts** (Google Fonts, OFL):

| Font | Use |
|---|---|
| Inter | Interface text |
| Fraunces | Headlines |
| Caveat | Notebook ink |
| JetBrains Mono | Data |

**Maps:** India is always drawn from the DataMeet Survey-of-India outline. All other boundaries come from Natural Earth's India point-of-view dataset. Crimea is shown inside Ukraine's internationally recognised boundary.

## How to render

See `tools/masterclass-video/README.md`.

1. `timeline.py --cut hub|ext` turns the script into a timeline for one cut (estimated at 135 wpm, or `--align` to a recording).
2. `sound_bed.py` builds the self-made bed (pad, bells, page turn), mixed with the voice when there is one.
3. `render.js` renders it. `--strict` stops if any word cue is missing from the narration.

## Motion grammar (v2, from the motion review)

- **Word-keyed builds:** every build lands on the word it explains (`→ "word"` in the script). Nothing builds a sentence early or late.
- **Living holds:** text, diagram and desk scenes push in 2–3.5% across each row; map and footage scenes run their own camera moves. No frame is frozen.
- **Pauses:** each "Pause and answer" countdown runs inside its own row, over 7 s of real silence, with a bell. The ring is hidden while she speaks.
- **Text sizes:** body ≥ 32 px, nodes ≥ 34 px, secondary and credit lines ≥ 24 px; chapter banners 40 px, top-centre, about 4 s.
- **Sound:** a low synthesised pad, ducked under the voice, rising in holds and under the end screen; a bell per countdown; a page turn on the Decode Archive.
